import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXT = 62;
    static int R, C, T;
    static char[] c = new char[MAXT];
    static long[] r1score = new long[MAXT];
    static long[] rscore = new long[MAXT];
    static long[] lscore = new long[MAXT];
    static long mval;
    static Map<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> state_map = new HashMap<>();

    static class Pair<U, V> {
        public U first;
        public V second;
        public Pair(U first, V second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair<?, ?> pair = (Pair<?, ?>) o;
            return Objects.equals(first, pair.first) && Objects.equals(second, pair.second);
        }
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(first, second);
        }
    }

    static long choose(int x, int y) {
        if (y > x || y < 0) return 0;
        long res = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < y; i++) {
            res = res * (x - i) / (i + 1);
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        R = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = 2 * R + 2 * C;

        String line = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            c[i] = line.charAt(i);
        }

        Arrays.fill(lscore, 0);
        lscore[2 * R - 1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2 * R; i < T; i++) {
            lscore[i] = lscore[i - 1] * i / (i - 2 * R + 1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
            r1score[i] = choose(i, R - 1);
            rscore[i] = choose(i, R);
        }

        mval = 0;
        int acnt = 0, bcnt = 0;
        for (int i = T - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            boolean u = mval > 0;
            if (bcnt == T / 2) u = true;
            if (acnt == T / 2) u = false;

            if (u) {
                acnt++;
                mval -= r1score[T / 2 - acnt] * rscore[T / 2 - bcnt];
            } else {
                bcnt++;
                mval += r1score[T / 2 - bcnt] * rscore[T / 2 - acnt];
            }
        }
        mval = Math.max(mval, -mval);

        long total_score = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) total_score += lscore[i];

        total_score = rscore[T/2] * rscore[T/2];

        state_map.put(new Pair<>(0L, 0), 1L);
        for (int i = T - 1; i >= 2 * R - 1; i--) {
            Map<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> new_map = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> entry : state_map.entrySet()) {
                long sum = entry.getKey().first;
                int acnt2 = entry.getKey().second;
                long count = entry.getValue();

                int aleft = T/2 - acnt2;
                int bleft = i + 1 - aleft;

                long asum = sum + r1score[aleft - 1] * rscore[bleft];
                long bsum = sum - r1score[bleft - 1] * rscore[aleft];

                if (c[i] == 'A') {
                    Pair<Long, Integer> key1 = new Pair<>(asum, acnt2 + 1);
                    new_map.put(key1, new_map.getOrDefault(key1, 0L) + count);
                    Pair<Long, Integer> key2 = new Pair<>(bsum, acnt2);
                    new_map.put(key2, new_map.getOrDefault(key2, 0L));
                } else if (c[i] == 'B') {
                    Pair<Long, Integer> key1 = new Pair<>(asum, acnt2 + 1);
                    new_map.put(key1, new_map.getOrDefault(key1, 0L));
                    Pair<Long, Integer> key2 = new Pair<>(bsum, acnt2);
                    new_map.put(key2, new_map.getOrDefault(key2, 0L) + count);
                } else {
                    Pair<Long, Integer> key1 = new Pair<>(asum, acnt2 + 1);
                    new_map.put(key1, new_map.getOrDefault(key1, 0L) + count);
                    Pair<Long, Integer> key2 = new Pair<>(bsum, acnt2);
                    new_map.put(key2, new_map.getOrDefault(key2, 0L) + count);
                }
            }
            total_score -= lscore[i];

            Map<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> temp_map = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> entry : new_map.entrySet()) {
                long sum = entry.getKey().first;
                int acnt2 = entry.getKey().second;
                long count = entry.getValue();

                int aleft = T/2 - acnt2;
                int bleft = i - aleft;
                if (acnt2 > T/2 || (T - i - acnt2) > T/2) continue;
                long lsum = rscore[aleft] * rscore[bleft];
                if (sum < (-mval - lsum) || sum > (mval + lsum)) continue;
                Pair<Long, Integer> key = new Pair<>(sum, acnt2);
                temp_map.put(key, temp_map.getOrDefault(key, 0L) + count);
            }
            state_map = temp_map;
        }

        long min_bscore = Long.MAX_VALUE / 2;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> entry : state_map.entrySet()) {
            long sum = entry.getKey().first;
            min_bscore = Math.min(min_bscore, Math.max(sum, -sum));
        }

        long answer = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> entry : state_map.entrySet()) {
            long sum = entry.getKey().first;
            int acnt2 = entry.getKey().second;
            long count = entry.getValue();

            if (sum == min_bscore || sum == -min_bscore) {
                int nleft = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 2 * R - 1; i++) {
                    if (c[i] == 'A') acnt2++;
                    if (c[i] == '?') nleft++;
                }
                count *= choose(nleft, T/2 - acnt2);
                answer += count;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
